sandbox.title: Simulator sandbox
sandbox.description: A cobot model in the browser. Drag the sliders to move the joints — the robot follows and stays within its limits.
sandbox.placeholderNotice: A training stand-in, not a PROMPOWER model. Its geometry and joint limits are arbitrary and will be replaced once the real URDF arrives.
sandbox.loadFailedTitle: The robot model could not be loaded
sandbox.loadFailedHint: Check that the URDF is reachable at {url} and that the joint names in the plugin match the URDF.
